inputs.prompt:
Create one full-body character concept for a Korean Joseon dark-fantasy isometric action RPG, head to feet inside a vertical 2:3 composition with a little space below the feet. One adult Korean woman, the revealed human-form boss of the tavern hostess in the supplied two-panel reference. The reference defines her exact recognizable face, focused almond-shaped amber-gold eyes beneath lowered eyelids, lowered chin, restrained knowing asymmetric smile, black hair, plain wooden hairpin and matte hand-painted art style. Keep her mesmerizing, quietly predatory eye contact aimed toward the viewer; never cute, vacant, shouting or snarling. Make the beautiful adult human face clearly readable. Render one uninterrupted composition with one person, not the reference's split panels.

Her faded-indigo cotton jeogori, off-white collar, brown wrap chima and plain pale work apron identify the ordinary tavern hostess underneath the revealed corruption. Design a complete waist-length jacket with broad overlapping front panels, attached sleeves, actual seams, continuous hems and recognizable goreum ties. Garment exposure must follow a real opened neckline, displaced overlapping skirt panel or continuous open-ended seam damage as specified below. Show visible cloth attachment points, tension folds and gravity. The chest and hips remain covered with opaque cloth. Never turn the jeogori into a detached narrow breast band, knotted crop top, belly window or isolated circular shoulder hole. The skirt is supported by its actual waistband and has heavy hanging cotton folds. Retain ordinary Joseon cloth construction; no Western lingerie, harness, crown, jewelry, ornate queen gown or shiny armor.

Keep her face beautiful, human and composed against physically brutal hands. Long physical claws, fresh blood under the nails and on the fingers and wrist, smeared bloody handprints, heavy dark-red blood-soaked apron and lower skirt folds. Some dark organic skin discoloration at the exposed neck and wrists; living clean skin remains distinct from blood and corruption. Natural human anatomy, two arms, two human legs and grounded weight-bearing feet. No giant body or quadruped hybrid.

Nine substantial charcoal-black physical fox tails connect behind the lower back and occupy the space around her with asymmetrical low-trailing and raised rear arcs. Coarse matte fur and dense real mass; no decorative symmetrical halo, no tails covering the face, hands or crucial garment connections. A dim wooden Korean tavern with minimal background detail, cool shadows and restrained warm directional light. Matte painterly skin and tactile cotton, wood and fur, large readable dark-fantasy shapes. Amber eyes reflect light rather than emit it. Phase-one physical menace: no glowing magic, fire, purple aura, insect armor, scorpion appendages, extra limbs, text or watermark.

Specific concept direction, garment cause and acting:
Three-quarter twisting stance immediately after feeding, hips turned while her familiar face turns back toward the viewer in calm dangerous pleasure. Both shoulders remain covered. An open-ended ragged tear rises from the jacket side hem along its side seam; loose connected cloth edges hang under gravity, revealing one flank without a circular cutout. The skirt's real wrap edge has fallen open on that side, while its waistband stays intact. Blood stains her lower lip, clawed fingers and rumpled apron. The tails are dragged low behind the turning hips.
